sections.description: Construction Company WDA is a fully responsive and powerful WordPress theme. The theme is an ideal solution for construction company websites. Whether you want to create a new website or redesign an existing one, our construction theme will help you with it. WordPress Construction Company theme comes with many great features like beautiful popup search bar, animation effects, customizable top bar, customizable header with different layouts, header cart, different font families, custom and numeric pagination, ready to use customizable homepage with different sections, breadcrumbs, different design settings for WooCommerce, three available layout sizes, customizable 404 page, product search bar, settings available for blog page, footer settings, button animations, patterns, and much more. Most of these features are available in the free version of the theme, while the premium version comes with even more features to enhance the functionality of the theme. WordPress Construction Company theme is also integrated with WooCommerce. This means that you can also use the theme to sell products or for any other purpose. The theme's custom homepage has various sections with default content. This means you just need to enable the sections and a powerful and functional construction company website is ready. Of course, you can change any of the default images or text and replace them with your own. There are more than 12 homepage sections available, and each of these sections has its own purpose. Some of the available sections are: Hero Banner, Call to Action, Sales, Latest Posts, Advantages, Services, Benefits, Parallax Banner, Benefits of Ordering, Shop by Category, Brands, etc. WordPress Construction Company theme also has different layout sizes. This means that if you need a site with a normal, wide, or full screen, then there will be no problems. You can configure it on the theme settings page. Most construction sites use the full-width option, so we recommend that as well. Finally, if you want to know more about Construction Company theme, you can visit our website and check out the demo site to see it in action.
